items.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
items.title_zh: Gemini Robotics ER 2：以视频理解、任务编排和多机器人协作赋能机器人
items.summary: Google DeepMind says Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate and solve real-world tasks, describing a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration and multi-robot collaboration.

items.title: MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: MANTA：面向自演化多智能体系统的网络拓扑自适应
items.summary: MANTA lets multi-agent communication structures self-evolve at inference time, starting from a task-conditioned topology and applying bounded updates to roles, links, execution order and validation pathways when collaboration becomes insufficient. It scores 74.0 on average across five benchmarks, 5.8 points above the strongest baseline, with the best result on PlanCraft.

items.title: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
items.title_zh: OSReward：跨平台计算机使用奖励模型的标准化评估
items.summary: OSReward evaluates vision-language judges on computer-use agent trajectories and finds a systematic leniency bias that labels failed runs as successes, while the most reliable judges are too expensive to run at scale. The authors release OS-Shepherd-100K and train 9B and 35B open reward models that match commercial judges at 30-60x lower cost.

items.title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
items.title_zh: EMBL AI Librarian：面向 AI 智能体的生命科学知识层
items.summary: EMBL introduces a knowledge layer that upgrades Europe PMC's 40M+ indexed records for AI agents, enabling natural-language queries and evidence-based retrieval. On ScholarQABench it improves Citation F1 by more than 16 points, and a GPT-5.4 agent scored 8 points higher when grounded in Librarian rather than web search.

items.title: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
items.title_zh: 基准并非铁板一块：面向 LLM 评估的样本级审计与编排
items.summary: The paper introduces a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that annotates benchmark samples along five latent dimensions and applies it to MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag and TruthfulQA. The annotations expose internal heterogeneity that aggregate accuracy hides and enable criterion-driven composition of benchmark subsets.

items.title: LLMBDC: Language Model for Biological Domains Oriented Clustering of Gene Ontology
items.title_zh: LLMBDC：面向基因本体生物学域聚类的大语言模型框架
items.summary: LLMBDC is a training-free framework that uses zero-shot LLM reasoning with confidence scoring to cluster Gene Ontology terms into interpretable BioDomains. On Alzheimer's disease and Fragile X syndrome data it raises ARI from 9.7% to 73.3% and from 15.7% to 66.6%, respectively, over REVIGO.

items.title: MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Query-Driven Summarization of Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Assessments
items.title_zh: MA-RAG：面向帕金森病纵向评估查询式摘要的多智能体检索增强生成
items.summary: MA-RAG splits clinical reasoning across domain-specialized agents, combines structured fact extraction and adds a final verification stage to summarize single-session and longitudinal Parkinson's disease assessments. It reports up to a 122% relative gain in Fact Precision (0.436 to 0.990) and up to a 98% reduction in hallucination rate (0.564 to 0.010) over RAG baselines.

items.title: Model or Harness? An Interaction-Centric Taxonomy for Localizing Agent Failures
items.title_zh: 模型还是框架？面向智能体故障定位的交互中心分类法
items.summary: The paper proposes an interaction-centric taxonomy that assigns 41 agent failure modes to the interactions where they originate, identifying whether the model, harness, environment or grader should be repaired. Across four frontier models, the strongest LLM judge reaches Cohen's kappa of 0.76 against human category labels.

items.title: ReToken: Improving Long-Context VLMs with Visual Retrieval Token
items.title_zh: ReToken：以视觉检索令牌改进长上下文视觉语言模型
items.summary: ReToken learns a single embedding that extracts retrieval signals from a vision-language model's internal representations to select query-relevant visual tokens from the pre-filled KV cache, without a separate retriever. It improves Qwen3VL-8B by 13.4 points and InternVL3.5 by 12.4 points on Visual Haystacks and transfers zero-shot to long video on LVBench.

items.title: AgiBot WITA-Omni Full-Modal Model Tops DailyOmni Global Leaderboard: Beating Google Gemini, ByteDance Doubao, and Alibaba Qwen at Embodied Cross-Modal Understanding
items.title_zh: 智元 WITA-Omni 全模态模型登顶 DailyOmni 全球排行榜
items.summary: AgiBot's WITA-Omni scores 85.21 on the DailyOmni benchmark and takes first place in 6 of 8 indicators with a Thinker-Talker-Actor architecture that synchronizes speech, action and expression on a single timeline, beating Google Gemini, ByteDance Doubao and Alibaba Qwen.

items.title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime
items.title_zh: avatarin 如何用 GPT-Realtime 构建 24/7 零售智能体
items.summary: avatarin uses OpenAI's GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support, and OpenAI reports that 30,000 people used the agent in two weeks with 92% positive survey responses.
